propositions: Nine modules are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC cap, blocking work that requires adding parameters at call sites in gate_dispatch.py (1 line headroom) and orchestrator.py (4 lines headroom).

gate_dispatch.py must be split along its existing plan-review recovery call-graph seam to extract ~300 LOC into plan_review_recovery.py, leaving gate_dispatch with ~270 lines of headroom to accommodate story 343b's provider_provenance parameter threading.
orchestrator.py must be split along its run-scoped context-assembly seam to extract ~157 LOC into context_assembly.py, leaving orchestrator with ~160 lines of headroom.

Extracted modules must preserve reference styles (lazy imports and attribute access) and re-export moved names into origin modules so existing test monkeypatches and string-based patches continue to resolve without edits.
Neither extracted module must fall below 100 LOC (anti-fragmentation floor), and full test suite must pass with zero test edits and only new seam-coverage tests added.
